summary: Iter42 E2E verification of the 5 requested changes. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_quiz_progress_iter42.py — 6/6 PASS in 27.66s): POST /api/quiz/progress round-trip persists {email,name,role,answers,current,total,completed:false}; GET /api/quiz/progress/{sid} without prior save returns a user shell (answers={},current=0); GET on unknown sid → 404; POST with unknown session_id → 404; upsert semantics verified (2nd POST overwrites current + accumulates answers); POST /api/quiz/generate-report marks db.quiz_progress.completed=true and (best-effort) cancels reminders. FRONTEND E2E via preview URL (16/16 checkpoints PASS): (1) /diagnose → role_option_senior_manager → user-info-form (name/email/phone) → /quiz; (2) PART 5 server-progress — answered 5 questions, observed 10 POSTs to /api/quiz/progress; (3) PART 5 resume — after page reload the quiz lands on 'Frage 6 von 20' (NOT Q1, NOT Q5); (4) PART 5 cross-device — /quiz?resume=<sid> in a fresh browser context (no localStorage) does NOT redirect to /diagnose and rehydrates the user, landing on quiz-page; (5) PART 1 — after Q20 the wladbot-q20 chat appears with the 'Optional · du kannst direkt weiter' badge, and wladbot-continue reads exactly 'Meinen Report jetzt erstellen' (no '30-Tage-Plan aktivieren'); (6) PART 2 — clicking wladbot-continue navigates to /analyzing, analyzing-page contains '60 Sekunden' + 'auf dieser Seite', then auto-navigates to /report; (7) PART 3 — report-packages section rendered with the free-vs-paid banner 'Dein Report & 30-Tage-Plan sind kostenlos', headline 'DAS STECKT IN DEN PAKETEN', 4-stat bar (10/72/12 h/10), report-package-os with report-course-os-0..5, report-package-plus with report-course-plus-0..3 plus 'Live dabei' badge, course-row click expands the teaser, and both CTAs report-packages-cta-sprint + report-packages-cta-library navigate to /close.

issues: React dev warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires repeatedly when the /close page renders (non-blocking; probably a .map() on a list containing duplicate ids). Not caused by this iteration but was observable in the console traces.

Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fires twice on initial /report mount before the container has laid out. Cosmetic — the chart renders correctly after layout. Not caused by this iteration.

action_items: Optional cleanup: fix duplicate-key React warning on /close (HighTicketClose).
Optional cleanup: give Recharts container a min-height / defer render until layout so the width(-1)/height(-1) warning stops.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/quiz.py generate_report wraps quiz_progress completion + cancel_quiz_reminders in a bare 'except Exception: pass' — if the cancel step ever silently fails the 2h/24h reminder mails will still ship. Consider logging at warning level so scheduling regressions are visible.
routes/quiz.py get_quiz_progress fall-back returns the raw user.email (case as stored) while save_quiz_progress writes it lowercased. Minor consistency issue for downstream email lookups.

Quiz.jsx line 217 fires POST /api/quiz/progress on every state change of `answers`/`current` — during a 20-question run we observed ~10 posts. Fine, but a small debounce would reduce write amplification on Mongo.
test_credentials: None required for the funnel; unique TEST_iter42_*@example.com created per test run.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed 'TEST_iter42_' created via POST /api/user/create (one per test) + one generated report + quiz_progress rows. No seeded/production data modified.
